أتناغم (form VI)
# أَتَنَاغَمُ (ʔatanāḡamu) /ʔa.ta.naː.ɣa.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
# أَتَنَاغَمَ (ʔatanāḡama) /ʔa.ta.naː.ɣa.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
# أَتَنَاغَمْ (ʔatanāḡam) /ʔa.ta.naː.ɣam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَنَاغَمَ (tanāḡama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
